# Animation sources

GSAP 3.15.0, including ScrollTrigger and SplitText, downloaded from the official gsap npm package. Original copyright/license headers are retained in each file.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

The homepage title animation adapts the Vue Bits Split Text component, copyright (c) 2025 David Haz.
Source: https://vue-bits.dev/text-animations/split-text
License: vue-bits-LICENSE.md

Uses the official preview defaults: chars, y 40 → 0, opacity 0 → 1, 50ms stagger, 1.25s duration, power3.out, start top 90%-=100px. The original Vue lifecycle is replaced with a plain JavaScript lifecycle for this static website. Only eleven explicitly selected headings animate; upward entry reveals text immediately.
